name: djinn
description: Three-phase orchestrated code review relay: audit, deliberate, dispatch. Every run leaves a timestamped audit folder under audits/ and one line in audits/LEDGER.md. Reviewers work inside a git-derived fence against a configured base branch. Fixers execute one brief each inside a work-set guard. The next review round runs automatically after fixes land. Everything runs on Opus. /djinn:learn, a separate pipeline, turns one exam question into multi-angle study material and SFT, DPO and GRPO training data, with every claim cited to the repo or marked UNVERIFIED.
